Chapter 675: Chapter 11: The Battle A Billion Years Ago (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

The fusion between the pillar rules and the basic rules.

The fusion among the pillar rules themselves.

The strongest among the fusion rules, the fusion of pillar rules with other pillar rules, requires only one to be understood to rank as ‘Grade A’ among the tenth rank.

Whereas the fusion of pillar rules with basic rules ranks at least as ‘Grade C’ among the tenth rank, and some can reach the ‘Grade B’ tenth rank.

Normally, it is impossible for a ninth-rank powerhouse to comprehend fusion rules.

Due to insufficient realm, the main cultivation direction for ninth-rank life forms is to continuously open up spatial layers, making their inner worlds increasingly substantial.

...

This is the foundation for breaking through to the tenth rank.

However, Lin Yuan’s foundation was incredibly profound; although he was at the ninth rank, his understanding of the Space Rules and many basic rules was in no way inferior to those of the tenth-rank powerhouses.

“Is the rule resulting from the fusion of Space Rules and Golden Rules the ‘Spatial Rupture’ rule?” Lin Yuan quickly found the corresponding fusion rule in the human civilization database on fusion rules.

Even the fusion of two identical rules might result in different fusion rules.

For instance, the possible rules resulting from the fusion of Space Rules with Golden Rules could be the ‘Spatial Rupture’ rule, the ‘Spatial Shatter’ rule, the ‘Spatial Gold Blade’ rule, and so on.

“The Spatial Rupture rule is a combat-oriented fusion rule, extremely lethal, and one of the top rules in the second-tier fusion rules,” Lin Yuan thought quietly to himself.

Comprehending the Spatial Rupture rule greatly enhanced Lin Yuan’s combat power, allowing him to unleash a might that was not much weaker than a tenth-rank Grade B at full force.

One must know, Lin Yuan was just at the ninth rank, with a significant realm difference from the tenth rank. Even having comprehended the Spatial Rupture rule, theoretically, he was far from reaching the combat power of a tenth-rank Grade B.

The same blade, in the hands of a child and an adult, naturally exhibits vastly different powers.

But Lin Yuan’s accumulation in other aspects was also quite formidable.

Taking multiple aspects into account, he was almost at the same level as a normal tenth-rank Grade B.

“If I could step into the tenth rank, and tr

ansform all aspects like my physical soul, Spirit Will, and inner world, wouldn’t I be comparable to a tenth-rank Grade A?”

Lin Yuan thought, feeling slightly excited.

To possess the combat power of a tenth-rank Grade A right after breaking through to the tenth rank?

This had never happened before in the history of the Cosmic Starry Sky.

…

Comprehending the ‘Spatial Rupture’ rule was a delightful surprise for Lin Yuan.

He was earnestly comprehending the Rule of Time, but unexpectedly touched on this type of fusion rule, something he hadn’t anticipated at all.

But since he had comprehended it, it was naturally a good thing.

Just as Lin Yuan was planning to continue his comprehension.

“Hmm?”

“Has the information about that black planet been found?”

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred, and he immediately contacted the Goddess of Wisdom.

About the black life planet he discovered, after confirming he obtained the ‘leasing rights’ for that Star Domain, he immediately contacted the Goddess of Wisdom.

He aimed to use the vast human civilization data repository to figure out the origin of that black planet.

This was what Lin Yuan would do whenever he faced many treasures with unclear origins and uses.

When Lin Yuan had raided the Milky Way Star Region and obtained that Mysterious Gourd, he also immediately uploaded its image to the Goddess of Wisdom.

However, the human civilization’s recorded database did not contain any information on the Mysterious Gourd.

But this black planet, evidently, the Goddess of Wisdom found some related information clues.

“Respected Eighth Level Citizen Scholar Yuan, the information about the black planet you inquired about, after comparison, is suspected to come from a treasure that fell into the Universe from outside before the birth of human civilization,” said the Goddess of Wisdom, her voice solemn and cold.

A treasure that fell from outside the Universe?”

“Before the birth of human civilization?”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew somewhat stern.

The Eternal Spatial Rift in the Main Universe connects to the outside of the Universe and occasionally has objects drift in.

Over a hundred years ago, that segment of a Supreme Being’s body came in this way, eventually causing a murderous conflict among the top beings from the Peak Clans of the Great Alliance.

Quickly.

The Goddess of Wisdom then transmitted all information about the black planet to Lin Yuan.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan’s expression cleared.

Human civilization has only had a history of over two million years. Before that, the Starry Sky Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky were still fiercely competing, with the Supreme Beings sitting in power everywhere.

Until—

Many treasures from beyond the Universe fell.

Countless treasures, comparable to Eleven-Star and even Twelve-Star, continuously fell from the Eternal Spatial Rift into the Universe, instantly driving the then-Supreme Beings mad.

Treasures of Eleven-Star might not interest a Supreme Being, but those of Twelve-Star, especially top-quality Twelve-Star treasures, indeed made the Supreme Beings green with envy.

This caused a war that affected nearly all Supreme Beings across the Universe.

That battle was extremely brutal; numerous strong clans were wiped out, several Supreme Beings were severely injured, and many of the treasures that fell were scattered across the Universe due to the battle.

Many historical scholars of human civilization have repeatedly studied that great battle and deduced some conclusions, including that human civilization was able to rise smoothly because of that war.

Without that fierce battle, where Supreme Beings fought desperately and caused the extinction of nearly half of the Starry Sky Races, even if human civilization could reemerge, it would have taken much longer.

Simply put, the current flourishing state of human civilization could be attributed to the ‘dividends’ from that great war.

Furthermore, the architectural style on the black planet resembled many treasures that fell from outside the Universe during that era.”
